newsitem.title: GREECE: ECU/DRACHMA SOFTER, FORWARDS PARALYZED IN LATE DEALS.
newsitem.headline: ECU/DRACHMA SOFTER, FORWARDS PARALYZED IN LATE DEALS.

text.p: Greek depos and forex forwards were fluctuating in late lacklustre trade and ecu/drachma was marginally lower around 304.80/84, dealers said.
"Depos and forex forwards are stable in late unexciting trade," a private bank dealer said. "There is ample liquidity around and the central bank drained overnight funds again at 11.90 percent."
Ecu/drachma is hovering around 304.80/84 slightly lower from 305.0/05 early in the morning, forex dealers said.
Bond dealers said trading activity was subdued with prices of three-year fixed coupon bonds due 2000 having shed 30 basis points after light selling pressure early on.
Greece will auction 150 billion drachmas of three-year bonds, 100 billion drachmas of five-year coupon bonds and 50 billion of seven-year bonds on March 19.
The mark was quoted at 156.80/90 from Tuesday's 156.800 fix, the dollar at 267.47/57 drachmas from 267.630 and the Ecu at 304.78/88 from 304.920 drachmas.
